notes.title: End of Skellies Ain't Scary Development
notes.content:
[h1]Why Am I Dropping Skellies Ain't Scary?[/h1]
Hey, guys! First off, I want to thank everyone who has bought, played and left a review of Skellies Ain't Scary. It's been a 1 and a half year journey to get to this point! Skellies Ain't Scary is my first ever steam release, and I'm so glad that we've managed to get so far with this project.

However, that's all the more reason to stop developing this project. For a first-time commercial project, that isn't earning me a mind-boggling profit (in fact I'm still at a net loss right now), continuously working on this game just isn't worth it to me. Not to mention, when you work on the same project for years, burnout is sure to set in, and I've been really craving working on a new project, or just even pursuing a new hobby.

For that reason, I'm completely dropping Skellies Ain't Scary from my belt. That means no more content updates, except for bug reports whenever they happen.

[h1]What Now?[/h1]
If you didn't know, I have a [url=https://discord.gg/rDPunHuuan]discord server[/url] where I post updates on the game, or used to anyways. I'll try to stay active in the server, and convert it mostly to a general server for whatever new projects I work on, so if you're interested in that, feel free to join!

Other than that, you probably won't hear much from me! Once again, thank you all for the support so far, and I'm really proud of what I've achieved so far with my first commercial project. Now the next goal will be to make an actual profit!

-JBroook.

notes.title: FINAL UPDATE: V1.5 - New Content and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]New Room Type[/h1]
A new trap type room has been added to biome 3! This was originally meant to be in the game right from the start, but it was much too hard, and I excluded it to rebalance the entire thing. Now that it's done, you can try it out in biome 3!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/446967443672268800/1112677451764613160/image.png[/img]

[h1]More Statues[/h1]
I've also added more statues to the game that you can find randomly, it's nothing of note, just some extra references to things I find cool!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/446967443672268800/1112677605401956422/image.png[/img]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor problems with Transmogrified Eye
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: V1.4 - Visibility Changes!
notes.content:
[h1]Improved Visibility[/h1]
The game now has settings in the Game Settings section that will allow players to customize the RGB values for enemies and their bullets, thus improving visibility for players. Obviously this does interfere somewhat with the aesthetics of the game, which is why this is entirely optional. Although I do feel adding some color to the game has given it a nice look as well, so I recommend giving it a try at least once!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/446967443672268800/1112391205809033318/image.png[/img]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Tsuma's Blade crashes upon use against a homing Frog bullet
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: V1.4 Patch Live Now - Bug Fixes
notes.content:

notes.title: UPDATE: V1.1 Patch Out - Bug Fixes, UI, and Menus
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Hope everyone enjoys the game!

notes.title: Skellies Ain't Scary Releases Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
I'm happy to finally announce the release of Skellies Ain't Scary. As the sole developer of the game for the past year and a half, it's been an awesome and grueling journey to get to where we are currently. So many things have changed since I started this project, and I'm grateful for all of them.

One of the main things would definitely be my community! It's been an awesome time meeting all the new people in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rDPunHuuan]discord server[/url], and making friends with some truly wonderful people, especially our mods, and all the play-testers who helped prepare the game for launch. 

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Well, after release, I assume if there's enough players, I'll be dealing with a massive wave of bug reports and balancing issues for awhile. However, I'd love to try other community events again in the future, notably some treasure hunts, speedrun competitions and so on!

I also unfortunately had to release the game before I could add everything I wanted, so the game IS releasing in semi-early-access. If possible, I want to release an update in the future that will most likely involve content like:
[list]
[*] More weapons
[*] More items
[*] More enemies
[*] More room variations
[*] More bosses
[*] Lore
[/list]

That's just me talking right now though, who knows what will happen in the future! 

[h1]Closing[/h1]
Anyways, I made this post, because I figured it was high time I tried out the announcements feature and prepare something to fill up the steam page for my game before release! If you're reading this after buying the game post-release, I thank you from the bottom of my heart and hope you enjoy the game, if you want to support me, just join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rDPunHuuan]discord server[/url] or leave a nice review, thank you!
